text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Fufu, finishing in 1st place really feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying, but the moment you cross the finish line,
there's no one ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: A sight opened up before me, showing that my running had blazed the trail for this race...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That gives me a sense of accomplishment like nothing else!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you should be proud of it.
Yeah, you should be proud of it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'd really love to share more of that pride with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I could secure such a solid win
is because of your support.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm always counting on you.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
That's exactly why I'm making this declaration right now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna win the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "I won't slack on the effort needed for it. I'm fully prepared, so come at me without holding back!"
